name: ATR
description: Average True Range measures volatility. Check data.IsReady before using data.Current; zero is a valid ready ATR value. SampleCount reports accepted bars, Previous is the prior accepted ATR, and TrueRange is the latest accepted bar's range. Legacy currentValue and previousValue fields remain available for compatibility.

fields.label: ATR Period
fields.description: Number of true-range observations used to seed and calculate ATR.

fields.label: Smoothing Method
fields.description: Moving average applied to True Range. Wilder is the conventional ATR used by most charting platforms; Simple is a strict rolling window.
